explanation: This unit is 0 at every D1 and D2 step and lights up only at GO when the agent chooses a2: it sits at 9-10 when the agent has picked a2 for several trials in a row, about 2-8 on the first one or two a2 choices after switching over from a1, and it drops to 6-8 (sometimes 3) after one or two unrewarded trials in a row. At GO steps where the agent chooses a1 it is 0, rising to 1-3 when a long a1 run is close to switching to a2.
